description_fill_in: resume_id — Unique identifier of each synthetic resume (R0001 to R0500).
job_role — Job role the resume was submitted for. One of 5 roles: Data_Analyst, HR_Executive, Project_Manager, QA_Engineer, Software_Engineer.
years_exp — Candidate's total years of work experience (observed range 0 to 15).
skills_matched — Number of the job's required skills found in the resume (observed range 3 to 15).
education_score — Score for the candidate's education on a 0 to 100 scale; higher means a stronger education profile (observed range 60 to 100).
keyword_density — Fraction of job-description keywords that appear in the resume (observed range 0.10 to 0.90).
predicted_score — Resume-to-job match score on a 0 to 100 scale produced by the screening model (observed range 40.1 to 100).
shortlisted — Target label: 1 = shortlisted, 0 = not shortlisted (about 34.6% of resumes are 1).
shortlisted_label — Y/N version of shortlisted (Y = 1, N = 0), added during cleaning; it appears in dataset_cleaned.csv only, not in the original dataset.csv.
